findings.current: The young man, who had once been no more than a promising sprout, had sunk deep roots into the soil of the Murim and was growing into a mighty tree.
findings.defect: “Promising” reverses the idiom 싹수가 노랗다, which characterizes someone as seemingly unlikely to amount to anything, while the source extends that idiom through the sprout metaphor.
findings.rationale: The source contrasts Jin Taekyung’s apparently unpromising beginnings with his present growth; it does not call his early potential promising.
findings.replacement: The young man, who had once been no more than a sickly sprout that seemed unlikely to amount to anything, had put down deep roots in the soil of the Murim and was growing into a mighty tree.
findings.source: 싹수 노란 새싹에 불과하던 어린 청년은, 무림이라는 토양에 깊은 뿌리를 내리고 거목으로 자라나고 있었다.

findings.current: Amitabha. This humble monk is not such a free man.
findings.defect: “Free man” suggests personal liberty rather than 한가하다, meaning idle or unoccupied, and is unnatural in context.
findings.rationale: Jung Ho is saying he did not come because he had time to spare.
findings.replacement: Amitabha. This humble monk is not so idle.
findings.source: 아미타불. 빈승은 그리 한가한 사람이 아니라오.

findings.current: “He has no brains. But he has skill. Very strong.”
findings.defect: The translation changes a blunt joke about the monk having no hair into an accusation that he is stupid.
findings.rationale: 머리 refers to the bald monk’s hair here, preserving the giant’s literal-minded observation and the contrast with the monk’s tremendous skill.
findings.replacement: “He has no hair. But he has skill. Very strong.”

findings.defect: The possessive is misassigned and the identifying title is omitted. Sama Pyo is identifying the young monk as the Discipline Hall Master’s Martial Uncle.
findings.rationale: 계율원주의 modifies 사숙; the hierarchy is the point of Sama Pyo’s realization.
findings.replacement: “The Discipline Hall Master’s young Martial Uncle.”

findings.current: He threw his sword at the merchant cowering in a corner, then looked up at the sky and stretched.
findings.defect: “His sword” falsely assigns ownership to Sama Pyo, and “threw … at” can imply an attack rather than compliance with the order to return the weapon.
findings.rationale: The sword belongs to the merchant, whom Sama Pyo was just ordered to return it to; the source also retains the merchant’s trembling.
findings.replacement: He tossed the sword back to the merchant cowering and trembling in a corner, then looked up at the sky and stretched.
findings.source: 구석에 처박혀 벌벌 떠는 장사치를 향해 검을 내던진 그는 하늘을 바라보며 기지개를 쭉 켰다.

findings.current: At the final moment, he had seen a faint, proper light in the monk’s eyes beneath the conical hat. He recalled it now and muttered.
findings.defect: “Proper light” is not natural English and misses the moral or spiritual sense of 正光.
findings.rationale: 正光 denotes a righteous or upright radiance, not light that is merely correct or proper.
findings.replacement: He recalled the faint righteous gleam he had glimpsed in the monk’s eyes beneath the conical hat at the final moment, then muttered.
findings.source: 그는 마지막 순간, 죽립 아래로 보이던 은은한 정광(正光)이 어린 눈동자를 떠올리며 중얼거렸다.

findings.current: At a time like this, on a main road watched by countless eyes, the young man had not only beaten Blood Cudgel to death but had also attempted to provoke a senior of another sect.
findings.defect: “Another sect” reverses the relationship. Jung Ho is angered that Sama Pyo tried to provoke a revered senior of Jung Ho’s own sect, namely the Shaolin monk who is his Martial Uncle.
findings.rationale: 사문의 존장 refers to a respected senior within Jung Ho’s sect, not someone from an unrelated sect.
findings.replacement: At a time like this, on a main road under countless eyes, the young man had not only beaten Blood Cudgel to death but had also tried to provoke one of Shaolin’s senior figures.
findings.source: 요즘 같은 시기에, 그것도 대로변에서 수많은 이목이 지켜보는 가운데 혈곤을 쳐 죽인 것으로도 모자라 사문의 존장을 도발하려 하다니.

findings.current: *Because I followed that star when I first brought you here.*
findings.defect: The draft shifts the star-following from Hong Dao’s journey to retrieve the Disciple to the completed act of bringing him back, altering the sequence and function of the star.
findings.rationale: 데려올 때 describes the occasion on which Hong Dao went to fetch and bring the Disciple; the star guided that journey.
findings.replacement: *Because I followed that star when I first went to bring you back.*
findings.source: ‘너를 처음 데려올 때, 저 별을 따라갔으니까.’

findings.current: “For fuck’s sake, don’t just scream! A rope! Throw me a damn rope!”
findings.defect: The draft renders the single source profanity twice, unnecessarily intensifying the line.
findings.rationale: 씨벌 supports the opening profanity, but the second “damn” has no separate source equivalent.
findings.replacement: “For fuck’s sake, don’t just scream! A rope! Throw me a rope!”
findings.source: “아니 씨벌, 소리만 지르지 말고 밧줄! 밧줄 좀 던져봐!”

summary: The draft contains one reversed characterization, several altered relationship or action details, a lost baldness joke, and localized register and wording defects.
